name: stbimage
description: A single compiled instantiation of stb_image and stb_image_write, shared by Ghoul and SGCT so that linking both into the same program does not produce a duplicate-symbol/ODR conflict. See https://github.com/sgct/stbimage for details.

This port fetches the pinned commit directly from GitHub via vcpkg_from_github rather than resolving a local checkout. Ghoul and the OpenSpace superproject instead consume this same repository as a git submodule at ext/stbimage; see their own vcpkg.json for why.
